title: GitHub - vscarpenter/gsd-task-manager: 告别手忙脚乱，高效搞定任务。GSD Task Manager 让你可以轻松将待办事项按紧急程度与重要程度分类，从而彻底摆脱疲于奔命、高效成事。它简单、直观，并且完全支持离线运行。
author: vscarpenter
content:
A privacy-first Eisenhower matrix for deciding what to do, schedule, delegate, or eliminate.

Live app: gsd.vinny.dev Current version: 13.9.2 Current product: the v11 single-matrix shell, offline-first local storage, optional PocketBase sync, and the GSD MCP server.

What ships in v11

  • A responsive four-quadrant matrix with drag-and-drop movement.
  • Quick Capture, full task editing, search, keyboard navigation, and optional built-in Smart Views.
  • Due dates, tags, dependency selection, and circular-dependency prevention.
  • Archive, dashboard/review analytics, sync history, settings, and onboarding.
  • Local IndexedDB persistence, JSON import/export, offline PWA support, and user-controlled update prompts.
  • Optional multi-device PocketBase sync with Google, Apple, or GitHub OAuth and realtime server-sent events.
  • A separately installed MCP server with 19 task, analytics, and diagnostic tools, including validated and dry-run-aware writes.
  • Light and dark Inkwell "GSD Editorial" themes with WCAG AA as the accessibility floor.

Retired v7/v8 surfaces such as selection-mode batch operations, the Quick Settings panel, and smart-view pinning shortcuts are not part of the v11 shell.

Privacy and data custody

Local-only mode is the default. Tasks are stored in the browser's IndexedDB and the core product does not require a backend. Clearing browser data can erase local tasks, so export backups regularly.

Cloud sync is explicitly optional. When enabled, task data is sent to the configured PocketBase server; the hosted configuration uses https://api.vinny.io. Self-hosting instructions and the encryption-at-rest hooks live under docker/. See SECURITY.md for the precise trust and token-storage posture.

Using the matrix

The Eisenhower matrix classifies work by urgency and importance:

  • Do First — urgent and important.
  • Schedule — important, not urgent.
  • Delegate — urgent, not important.
  • Eliminate — neither urgent nor important.

Use the Quick Capture field or press n to start a task. Use Shift+N for the full composer, / for search, ? for help, and Option+1 through Option+4 (Alt on non-Mac keyboards) to focus a quadrant. The in-app help drawer is the canonical shortcut ledger.

Local development

Requirements: Bun 1.3.14, Node.js 22.22.2+ (or 24.15+ or 26+), and a current browser. bun run executes package scripts on Node, so tests, lint, and builds run on your installed Node.

bun install
bun dev

Open http://localhost:3000. A fresh browser profile starts at /about; use the Open App call to action to enter the matrix. PocketBase is not required for local task CRUD.

Canonical checks

bun run test
bun run test -- --coverage
bun typecheck
bun lint
bun run quality:shape
bun run license:check
bun audit --audit-level=high
bun run build
bun run test:e2e

Use bun run test, not bun test; the latter invokes Bun's built-in runner instead of Vitest. Playwright covers Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit. The optional authenticated PocketBase harness runs with:

bun run test:system:pocketbase

Architecture

  • Next.js 16 App Router static export; the application is client-side.
  • React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and the Violet Frost Inkwell tokens.
  • Dexie/IndexedDB for local data and PocketBase for optional cloud sync.
  • Vitest for unit/integration coverage and Playwright for browser coverage.
  • Bun workspaces, including packages/mcp-server/.

Start with ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/security-trust-boundaries.md, and the architecture decisions in docs/adr/.

Deployment

  • bun run build creates the static export in out/.
  • bun run deploy runs the production deployment script. Production (gsd.vinny.dev) is the only deploy target; the development deploy was retired on 2026-09-11.
  • docker/Dockerfile builds the self-hosted Caddy and PocketBase image.
  • cloudfront/response-headers-policy.json and the related scripts manage production response headers.

Uploading an artifact is not proof that the CDN or a running container serves it. Verify the deployed URL separately.

Release documentation checklist

Before changing the release version or announcing a feature:

  1. Compare the README version with package.json.
  2. Verify every feature claim in the current shell, not only in retained data models or archived ADRs.
  3. Run the canonical checks above and a production static build.
  4. Update the GitHub release notes, SECURITY.md, and the trust-boundary map when the release changes their claims.
  5. Treat source, tests, build artifacts, deployment, and live runtime as separate evidence states.

Contributing and security

Read CONTRIBUTING.md before making changes. Report vulnerabilities through the private process in SECURITY.md, not a public issue.

License

MIT
aiSummary: GSD Task Manager 是一款基于 Next.js 和 IndexedDB 构建的开源、隐私优先型艾森豪威尔矩阵应用，支持可选的 PocketBase 同步，并提供包含 19 个工具的 MCP 服务器。
oneSentenceSummary: GSD Task Manager 是一款基于 Next.js 和 IndexedDB 构建的开源、隐私优先型艾森豪威尔矩阵应用，支持可选的 PocketBase 同步，并提供包含 19 个工具的 MCP 服务器。
summary: GSD Task Manager 是一款围绕艾森豪威尔四象限法则设计的本地优先、注重隐私的任务管理工具。该应用主要通过 Next.js 静态导出与 IndexedDB 持久化在客户端运行，允许用户完全离线地记录、整理和规划任务优先级。它还支持通过 PocketBase 和 OAuth 进行可选的自托管或云端多设备同步。其核心亮点在于配套的模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，该服务器提供了 19 个用于任务操作、分析和诊断的专业工具，并具备校验写入机制，可与外部 AI 智能体工作流无缝集成。

mainPoints.point: 隐私优先架构：默认纯本地运行，支持可选后端同步
mainPoints.explanation: 任务通过 Dexie 存储在浏览器的 IndexedDB 中，无需强制依赖后端；同时支持通过 PocketBase 和 OAuth 实现可选的多设备同步。

mainPoints.point: 通过专属 MCP 服务器与 AI 智能体原生集成
mainPoints.explanation: 包含一个可独立安装的 MCP 软件包，提供 19 个涵盖任务操作、分析和诊断的工具，并支持感知试运行（dry-run-aware）的安全校验写入。

mainPoints.point: 兼顾无障碍体验的静态架构与完备产品功能
mainPoints.explanation: 具备全键盘导航、循环依赖防范、数据分析、符合 WCAG AA 标准的暗色模式等功能，底层基于 Next.js 16、React 19 和 Tailwind CSS 构建。

keyQuotes: 一款隐私优先的艾森豪威尔矩阵工具，用于决定哪些任务该立即做、排期做、委派他人或直接剔除。
默认采用纯本地模式。任务存储在浏览器的 IndexedDB 中，核心产品无需任何后端支持。
一个独立安装的 MCP 服务器，配备 19 个任务管理、分析和诊断工具，并支持已校验且感知试运行的写入操作。
